count.heading: The family of Leontine Kastl and Emil Herms
count.note: The 1985 list numbers one child, RON. The 1986 supplement (s076, "Page 60 Correction and Addition") adds a second child, CYNTHIA LEE (b. 3 Feb. 1953, d. 4 Feb. 1953), so the family has both.

count.heading: The family of Leontine Kastl and Emil Herms
count.note: The supplement's unnumbered "Children:" section names two children, but only one line is in list form: "RON still living. He married Anette George, and she died 6 Apr. 1981. He married (2) Rebecca Stewart—4 Sept. 1983." is a sentence about Ron, and "CYNTHIA LEE — (b) 3 Feb. 1953 (d) 4 Feb. 1953." is the new child. The check counts only Cynthia Lee's line; the family has both Ron and Cynthia Lee.
